title: Appendix containing Canons and Rulings not having Conciliar Origin but Approved by Name in Canon II. of the Synod in Trullo: The Prosphonesus of Theophilus, Archbishop of Alexandria, When the Holy Epiphanies Happened to Fall on a Sunday

verses.text:
The Prosphonesus of Theophilus,
Archbishop of Alexandria, When the Holy Epiphanies Happened to Fall on
a Sunday. Johnson gives the date
as about a.d. 385.  These are annotated
only by Balsamon.

Because the fast of Epiphany chances to fall on a
Lord’s day, let us take a few dates, and so break our fast, and
honour the Lord’s day, and shew our dislike of heresy, and yet
not wholly neglect the fast which should be observed on this day;
eating no more till our evening assembly at three
afternoon.
